title: In-Person Appointments Attendance Thresholds
content:
The attendance thresholds of In-Person Appointments are the same for every visit type. They are read against the patient's count of missed appointments inside a rolling look-back.

| Setting | Nurse Visit | Established Patient Office Visit | New Patient Office Visit | Annual Preventive Exam | Specialist Consultation | In-Office Procedure Visit | Advanced Imaging Appointment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Look-back for counting missed appointments (calendar months) | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Missed appointments that trigger a written attendance warning | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 | 2 |
| Missed appointments after which only same-day slots may be booked | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 | 3 |
| Length of the same-day-only restriction (calendar months from the triggering no-show) | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 |
| Missed appointments that refer the patient to the practice manager for dismissal review | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 | 4 |
| Calendar days of urgent care after a dismissal letter | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |

**How the rows read.** The look-back is a rolling window of 12 calendar months. At 2 missed appointments inside it a written attendance warning is due; at 3 the patient may book only same-day slots, for 6 calendar months counted from the no-show that triggered the restriction; at 4 the patient is referred to the practice manager for dismissal review. After a dismissal letter the group continues to provide urgent care for 30 calendar days.

**Illustration (hypothetical counts).** A patient whose count reaches 2 is at the warning row only; a count of 3 reaches the restriction row; a count of 4 reaches the dismissal-review row. Because the figures do not differ by visit type, the row reached depends only on the count.
